monthly_review.summary: You've increased intensity and efficiency this month, with faster paces, higher HR, more Zone 4 work, and improved aerobic efficiency — all while maintaining cadence stability.
monthly_review.highlight: Your aerobic efficiency improved by +0.64 m/sec per bpm — the largest single-month gain in your log — reflecting better oxygen utilization at given heart rates.

goal_tracker.message: You need 4.6 more km across 1 session to match last month's distance — aim for a 5.0 km run before month-end.

insights.title: Efficiency leap despite lower volume
insights.body: Aerobic efficiency rose from 13.28 to 13.92 m/sec per bpm (+0.64) even as monthly volume dropped — suggesting improved cardiovascular economy, likely driven by increased Zone 3–4 time (62% this month vs 48% last month).

insights.title: Shift toward threshold and VO2 max stimulus
insights.body: Zone 4 time increased from 12% to 21%, and Zone 5 from 1% to 6% — indicating intentional high-intensity work, especially evident in the 7:25/km (428 sec/km) best pace on 2026-04-22 (HR 143 bpm, aerobic TE 3.1), which occurred at sub-threshold HR but elite pace.

insights.title: Stride length variability correlates with pace and effort
insights.body: Stride length ranged from 72.88 cm (slowest run, 9:08/km, HR 144) to 91.78 cm (fastest run, 7:13/km, HR 143) — a 26% increase — while ground contact time dropped from 314 ms to 298 ms, confirming efficient force application at faster efforts.

insights.title: Limited low-intensity recovery work
insights.body: Zone 1 time remains critically low (10% this month, down from 4% last month — still insufficient), with only one run showing HR <130 bpm; recent runs average HR ≥141 bpm, suggesting minimal true recovery stimulus.

recommendations.action: Do a 45-minute Zone 1 run (HR ≤128 bpm) before April 30 — use your 2026-04-08 run (HR 141, pace 8:58/km) as a baseline and slow 20–30 sec/km to drop HR into Z1.
recommendations.reason: Your Zone 1 time is only 10% — below the minimum 15–20% recommended for sustainable aerobic development and recovery.

recommendations.action: Repeat a 5.0 km tempo run at ~7:25/km (445 sec/km) targeting avg HR 158–162 bpm, mirroring your 2026-04-12 effort (7:42/km, HR 163, aerobic TE 4.6).
recommendations.reason: That run delivered your highest aerobic TE (4.6) and confirmed readiness for sustained threshold work — building on this improves lactate clearance and endurance.

recommendations.action: Add 2x 30-second strides (95% effort) after your next easy run, focusing on landing under center of mass — use your 2026-04-22 stride length (91.78 cm) as a target while keeping vertical oscillation ≤8.5 cm.
recommendations.reason: Vertical oscillation peaked at 8.8 cm on that run; controlled strides reinforce efficient posture and reduce bounce without increasing fatigue.

weekly_focus.description: Balance one high-quality threshold session with two easy runs anchored in true Zone 1 recovery, plus form-focused strides to lock in efficiency gains.
